<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        d[(n['color'],n['hash'])]=n['pixels']
    return d
def ppos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
before=snap(current_frame)
print("player before", ppos(current_frame))
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])  # red hat center
print("MOUSE red hat:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','board_changed')})
after=snap(current_frame)
print("player after", ppos(current_frame))
# diff
added={k for k in after if k not in before}
removed={k for k in before if k not in after}
changed={k for k in before if k in after and before[k]!=after[k]}
print("added",added); print("removed",removed); print("changed",changed)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
